en.circles.inbox.khatm_part_done.title: Group khatm
en.circles.inbox.khatm_part_done.body: A part of your group khatm was completed.
en.circles.inbox.khatm_completed.title: Group khatm complete
en.circles.inbox.khatm_completed.body: Your group khatm is complete. Alhamdulillah — take a moment for dua.
en.circles.inbox.dua_received.title: Someone made dua for you
en.circles.inbox.dua_received.body: A member of your circle made dua for you.
en.circleMembership.title: You in this circle
en.circleMembership.nameHint: Only members of this circle see it. Your account name and email are never shown.
en.circleMembership.pauseHint: While paused, your partners see "no signal" for you. You can resume any time.
en.circleMembership.leaveBody: Leaving is silent — nobody is notified. Anything you shared here is deleted after 30 days.
en.circleMembership.error: That didn't go through. Please try again.
en.partnerCircle.title: Accountability partner
en.partnerCircle.subtitle: Encourage each other quietly — only "done" is ever shared.
en.partnerCircle.gate: Partner circles need a signed-in account so your partners can find you again on any device.
en.partnerCircle.intro: Pick a private daily goal, then share a quiet "done" with 1–4 friends. There are no scores, percentages or rankings — just dots, dua and kind reminders.
en.partnerCircle.haveInvite: Have an invite code? Join a circle
en.partnerCircle.loadError: Couldn't load this circle. Check your connection and try again.
en.partnerCircle.waitingForPartner: Invite a partner below — the circle comes alive once someone joins.
en.partnerCircle.create.title: Start a partner circle
en.partnerCircle.create.body: A partner circle has 2–5 people who join by invite. Each of you keeps your own goal private.
en.partnerCircle.create.error: Couldn't create the circle. Please try again.
en.partnerCircle.goal.title: My daily goal
en.partnerCircle.goal.private: Private — stays on this device and is never shared
en.partnerCircle.today.title: Today
en.partnerCircle.today.shareHint: Shares only "done" for today — never what your goal is.
en.partnerCircle.today.shared: Shared "done" for today. May Allah accept it.
en.partnerCircle.today.notShared: Nothing shared yet today. Sharing is always optional — you can skip any day.
en.partnerCircle.today.looksMet: All five fard Salah are logged — share "done" if you'd like.
en.partnerCircle.today.excusedNote: You're on an excused period — no expectations. Share only if you want to.
en.partnerCircle.today.pausedNote: Sharing is paused. Your partners see "no signal" for you.
en.partnerCircle.today.error: That didn't go through. Please try again.
en.partnerCircle.dots.title: This week
en.partnerCircle.dots.subtitle: Today and the last 6 days
en.partnerCircle.dots.legend: A filled dot means "done". An empty dot is just "no signal" — it can mean a private, excused or skipped day, never "missed".
en.partnerCircle.nudge.makeDuaHint: Make dua for them now; they'll see "Someone made dua for you" without your name.
en.partnerCircle.nudge.remindHint: Sends one fixed, kind reminder. They see it only after their own Isha time, without your name.
en.partnerCircle.nudge.duaSent: May Allah accept your dua. They'll know someone made dua for them.
en.partnerCircle.nudge.alreadyDua: You've already let them know about a dua today. Keep them in your dua — you can tell them again tomorrow.
en.partnerCircle.nudge.alreadyReminder: You've already sent a gentle reminder today. One a day is enough — try again tomorrow.
en.partnerCircle.nudge.offline: You're offline. Please try again when you're connected.
en.partnerCircle.nudge.error: That didn't go through. Please try again.
en.partnerCircle.received.title: For you
en.partnerCircle.received.duaToday: Someone made dua for you today.
en.partnerCircle.received.duaWeek: Someone made dua for you this week.
en.partnerCircle.received.reminder: A gentle reminder from your circle: there is still time tonight. May Allah make it easy for you.
en.partnerCircle.received.returnDua: You could return the kindness with a dua for your circle.
en.partnerCircle.invite.title: Invite a partner
en.partnerCircle.invite.hint: A partner circle holds up to 5 people. Each invite works once and expires in 7 days.
en.partnerCircle.privacy.title: What your partners can see
en.partnerCircle.privacy.body: Only a "done" dot for the days you choose to share, and the name you pick for this circle. Your goal, your Salah log, notes and qaza are never sent. Duas and reminders are anonymous, and there are no scores, percentages or leaderboards.
en.partnerCircle.evidence.title: Why make dua for each other
en.partnerCircle.evidence.intro: The Prophet ﷺ taught that a dua made for a brother or sister in their absence is answered, and the angel says: "and for you the same".
en.partnerCircle.evidence.m2733: Dua for a fellow Muslim in their absence is answered (Sahih Muslim 2733)
en.partnerCircle.evidence.m2732: The angel says "and for you the same" (Sahih Muslim 2732)
en.khatmGroups.title: Group khatm
en.khatmGroups.subtitle: Finish the Qur'an together, one part each.
en.khatmGroups.loadError: Couldn't load this group. Check your connection and try again.
en.khatmGroups.noSession: Open the app once while online to start or join a group khatm.
en.khatmGroups.haveInvite: Have an invite code? Join a group
en.khatmGroups.list.emptyBody: Start one for your family, friends or masjid circle, or join with an invite link.
en.khatmGroups.privacy.title: What the group sees
en.khatmGroups.privacy.body: The part grid, the name you choose for this group and the group's total. There are no per-person tallies or rankings — every part read is for Allah.
en.khatmGroups.noKhatm: There's no khatm in this group yet.
en.khatmGroups.grid.title: Parts
en.khatmGroups.grid.hint.self_pick: Tap an open part to claim it.
en.khatmGroups.grid.hint.round_robin: At the start of each round, parts are dealt out in turn to the members. Anyone can give a part back for others to claim.
en.khatmGroups.grid.legend: Dashed = open · grey = claimed · tinted = reading · ✓ = done. A small dot marks a part that has been idle for a while.
en.khatmGroups.sheet.doneNote: This part has been read. May Allah accept it.
en.khatmGroups.sheet.noActions: Nothing to do here right now.
en.khatmGroups.sheet.staleMine: No rush — if you can't finish it, you can give it back for someone else to read.
en.khatmGroups.sheet.askFirst: {{name}} may still be reading this part. Please check with them first before giving it to someone else.
en.khatmGroups.sheet.returnToPool: Return it to the open parts
en.khatmGroups.toast.claimed: It's yours. May Allah make it easy.
en.khatmGroups.toast.completed: Marked done. May Allah accept it.
en.khatmGroups.error.conflict: Someone else changed this part just now — the grid has been refreshed.
en.khatmGroups.error.gone: This invite has expired or been used up.
en.khatmGroups.error.notFound: This group or khatm is no longer available.
en.khatmGroups.error.forbidden: Only the organisers can do that.
en.khatmGroups.error.rateLimited: Too many tries — please wait a moment.
en.khatmGroups.error.offline: You're offline. Please try again when you're connected.
en.khatmGroups.error.unknown: That didn't go through. Please try again.
en.khatmGroups.myParts.title: My parts
en.khatmGroups.deadline.decisionBody: Some parts aren't finished yet. You can give everyone more time, or open the unfinished parts so anyone can pick them up.
en.khatmGroups.deadline.openRemaining: Open the remaining parts to everyone
en.khatmGroups.deadline.opened: Unfinished parts are open to everyone
en.khatmGroups.complete.title: Alhamdulillah — the khatm is complete
en.khatmGroups.complete.body: Every part has been read. Take a quiet moment for dua, for yourselves and for those you intended.
en.khatmGroups.share.message: We're completing the Qur'an together on Munib Tracker.
en.khatmGroups.invite.title: Invite people
en.khatmGroups.invite.hint: Anyone with the link can join — even without an account. A khatm invite works for up to 200 people and expires in 7 days.
en.khatmGroups.intentionNote.title: About intentions
en.khatmGroups.intentionNote.body: You may write an intention, such as Ramadan or a loved one who has passed away. Scholars differ on gifting the reward of recitation to the deceased; the app makes no claim either way.
en.khatmGroups.create.screenSubtitle: Share the Qur'an out in parts and finish it together.
en.khatmGroups.create.title: Khatm title
en.khatmGroups.create.intentionHint: Visible to members of this group.
en.khatmGroups.create.tagMasjidHint: Shows {{name}} on the group — display only.
en.khatmGroups.create.tv: Start a group khatm from your phone; you can follow it here.
en.tour.steps.partnerKhatm.title: Partner & group khatm
en.tour.steps.partnerKhatm.body: Encourage a friend with a quiet "done" and a dua for each other, or finish the Qur'an together by sharing out its parts.
